grammar: n. 胡椒粉，通常不可数；菜椒、甜椒时为可数名词，复数 peppers。
collocations: black pepper; red peppers; add pepper to the soup
commonMistake: pepper 可指胡椒粉或菜椒；胡椒粉常不可数，指多个菜椒时用 peppers。

example.english: Add a little black pepper to the soup.
example.chinese: 往汤里加一点黑胡椒。

application.prompt: The recipe asks for a little salt and ___. A. pepper B. pancake
application.solution: A。解析：pepper 可指调味用的胡椒粉。

grammar: phr. 切碎；剁碎。是可分短语动词，名词宾语可置于 up 前后，代词必须放中间。
collocations: cut up an onion; cut the vegetables up; cut it up
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时说 cut it up，不说 cut up it；cut up 后接食材表示切碎。

example.english: Cut up the carrots before you put them in the pot.
example.chinese: 把胡萝卜切碎后再放进锅里。

application.prompt: The apples are too large for the salad. Please cut ___ up. A. them B. up them
application.solution: A。解析：可分短语动词后接代词时，代词放在 cut 和 up 之间。

grammar: v.（使）混合；调配；n. 混合物；混杂。动词常用 mix A with B 或 mix A and B together。
collocations: mix flour with water; mix the ingredients; a cake mix
commonMistake: 表示把 A 和 B 混合可说 mix A with B；mix 作名词时表示混合物或混合料。

example.english: Mix the eggs with the flour in a large bowl.
example.chinese: 在大碗里把鸡蛋和面粉混合。

application.prompt: First, ___ the flour with some water. A. slice B. mix
application.solution: B。解析：把两种食材混合用 mix A with B。

grammar: v. 烘焙；烤制。规则变化 bake—baked—baked；常指用烤箱加热制作食物。
collocations: bake a cake; bake bread; bake in the oven
commonMistake: bake 常指用烤箱烘烤；bake 的过去式为 baked，不要与 boil（煮）混淆。

example.english: We baked a cake for the school fair.
example.chinese: 我们为学校义卖会烤了一个蛋糕。

application.prompt: Put the bread in the oven and ___ it for 20 minutes. A. mash B. bake
application.solution: B。解析：在烤箱中烤面包用 bake。

grammar: n. 烤箱；烤炉。可数名词，复数 ovens；通常说 in the oven 或 turn the oven on。
collocations: a hot oven; preheat the oven; cook it in the oven
commonMistake: oven 是可数名词；表示把食物放进烤箱通常用 in the oven，不用 on the oven。

example.english: The potatoes are cooking in the oven.
example.chinese: 土豆正在烤箱里烤。

application.prompt: You bake a cake in an ___. A. island B. oven
application.solution: B。解析：烘烤蛋糕使用 oven（烤箱）。

grammar: phr. 把某物倒入某处。pour + 液体 + into + 容器；pour...out of... 表示从某处倒出。
collocations: pour milk into a cup; pour the soup into a bowl; pour water into the pot
commonMistake: 表示倒入用 pour sth into sth；into 强调进入容器内部，不要和 onto（到表面上）混淆。

example.english: Pour the warm milk into the bowl slowly.
example.chinese: 把温牛奶慢慢倒进碗里。

application.prompt: Carefully ___ the water ___ the glass. A. boil; with B. pour; into
application.solution: B。解析：把水倒入杯中用 pour the water into the glass。

grammar: n. 面粉；通常不可数。a bag of flour 表示一袋面粉。
collocations: plain flour; a bag of flour; mix flour with water
commonMistake: flour（面粉）与 flower（花）同音，拼写和词义不同；面粉通常不加 a。

example.english: We need flour, eggs, and milk to make pancakes.
example.chinese: 做薄饼需要面粉、鸡蛋和牛奶。

application.prompt: The white powder used to make bread is ___. A. flour B. flower
application.solution: A。解析：制作面包用 flour（面粉）；flower 是花。

grammar: v. 煮沸；烧开；沸腾；n. 沸腾（较少用）。规则变化 boil—boiled—boiled；表示水沸腾可说 water boils。
collocations: boil water; boil an egg; bring the water to a boil
commonMistake: boil 作动词表示煮沸；说“把水烧开”可用 boil the water，水本身沸腾也可作主语。

example.english: Boil the potatoes until they are soft.
example.chinese: 把土豆煮到变软。

application.prompt: Heat the water until it starts to ___. A. boil B. slice
application.solution: A。解析：液体达到沸腾状态用 boil。

grammar: n. 黄油；通常不可数。表示一块或一份可说 a piece of butter；butter 也可作动词表示涂黄油。
collocations: a little butter; butter and bread; melt the butter
commonMistake: 食材 butter 通常不可数，不说 a butter；可说 some butter 或 a piece of butter。

example.english: Melt a little butter in the pan.
example.chinese: 在平底锅里融化一点黄油。

application.prompt: Add a small amount of ___ to the pan. A. butter B. instructions
application.solution: A。解析：黄油用量可说 a little butter。

grammar: n. 奶酪；通常不可数。表示一块奶酪可说 a piece of cheese；不同种类时可用 cheeses。
collocations: a piece of cheese; cheese sandwich; grated cheese
commonMistake: 泛指奶酪时通常不可数；不要说 a cheese 表示一块奶酪，可说 a piece of cheese。

example.english: She put some cheese on top of the potatoes.
example.chinese: 她在土豆上放了一些奶酪。

application.prompt: Would you like ___ on your baked potatoes? A. some cheese B. a cheese
application.solution: A。解析：泛指奶酪时用不可数形式 some cheese。

grammar: phr. 把某物切成某种形状或大小。cut sth into pieces/slices；cut sth in half 表示切成两半。
collocations: cut the onion into pieces; cut the cake in half; cut carrots into thin slices
commonMistake: 表示切成若干块常用 cut...into pieces；固定说 cut in half（切成两半）。

example.english: Cut the apple into four small pieces.
example.chinese: 把苹果切成四小块。

application.prompt: Before cooking, cut the potatoes ___ small pieces. A. during B. into
application.solution: B。解析：切成某种形状或大小用 cut sth into...。

grammar: n. 汤匙；一汤匙的量。可数名词，复数 tablespoons；食谱中常用 tbsp 作缩写。
collocations: a tablespoon of sugar; two tablespoons of oil; a tablespoon measure
commonMistake: 表示一汤匙某种食材说 a tablespoon of...；具体容量会因量匙标准而异，不把它当重量单位。

example.english: Add one tablespoon of oil to the pan.
example.chinese: 往锅里加一汤匙油。

application.prompt: The recipe needs two ___ of butter. A. tablespoons B. tablespoon's
application.solution: A。解析：two 后用复数 tablespoons；of 后接食材。

grammar: v. 捣烂；捣碎。规则变化 mash—mashed—mashed；常接 potatoes、fruit 等作宾语。
collocations: mash potatoes; mash a banana; mash the vegetables with a fork
commonMistake: mash 强调用力压碎成糊状；其过去式加 -ed：mashed。

example.english: Mash the cooked potatoes with a fork.
example.chinese: 用叉子把煮熟的土豆捣碎。

application.prompt: Use a fork to ___ the soft potatoes. A. mash B. pour
application.solution: A。解析：把煮软的土豆压碎用 mash。

grammar: n. 土豆泥。固定菜名，通常用复数 potatoes；mashed 是过去分词作定语，表示捣碎后的土豆。
collocations: a bowl of mashed potatoes; serve mashed potatoes; mashed potatoes with butter
commonMistake: 菜名固定说 mashed potatoes，potato 变复数为 potatoes；potatoes 前不加 a，但可说 a bowl of mashed potatoes。

example.english: We served mashed potatoes with the baked fish.
example.chinese: 我们把土豆泥和烤鱼一起端上桌。

application.prompt: Boiled potatoes crushed until smooth are called ___. A. sour soup B. mashed potatoes
application.solution: B。解析：捣碎的土豆菜肴是 mashed potatoes（土豆泥）。

grammar: v. 翻炒；炒；煸。作动词时 stir-fry—stir-fried—stir-fried；也可作名词指一道炒菜。
collocations: stir-fry vegetables; stir-fry the chicken; a vegetable stir-fry
commonMistake: 过去式在词尾加 -ed 并把 y 变 i：stir-fried；烹饪动作用 stir-fry，不是 stir and fry 的任意拼写。

example.english: Stir-fry the vegetables over high heat for two minutes.
example.chinese: 用大火把蔬菜翻炒两分钟。

application.prompt: Use a little oil to ___ the vegetables quickly in a pan. A. bake B. stir-fry
application.solution: B。解析：在锅里快速翻炒用 stir-fry。

grammar: phr. 处理；应付。常见结构为 what to do with sth/sb；do with 也见于 have something to do with（与……有关）。
collocations: what to do with leftovers; do something with the ingredients; have nothing to do with
commonMistake: what to do with sth 强调如何处理或使用某物；what to do about sth 强调针对问题采取措施，两种表达都正确，按语义选择。

example.english: What should we do with the extra vegetables?
example.chinese: 这些多出来的蔬菜我们该怎么处理？

application.prompt: There is some soup left. What should we ___ it? A. warm up with B. do with
application.solution: B。解析：询问“如何处理某物”用 what to do with。

grammar: n. 碗；钵；盆。可数名词，复数 bowls；a bowl of + 食物表示“一碗……”。
collocations: a bowl of soup; a mixing bowl; two bowls of rice
commonMistake: 表示一碗某物用 a bowl of；数量词 bowl 后接 of，不直接说 a bowl soup。

example.english: He ate a bowl of hot soup after the walk.
example.chinese: 散步后他喝了一碗热汤。

application.prompt: Please put the flour in a large ___. A. bowl B. oven
application.solution: A。解析：混合食材通常放在 bowl（碗、钵）里。

grammar: v. 加热；变热；n. 热；高温。heat sth 表示加热某物；heat up 表示（使）热起来。
collocations: heat the oil; heat up the soup; in the heat of summer
commonMistake: heat 作动词通常直接接被加热的物品；heat 是名词时不可数，表示热量或炎热。

example.english: Heat the pan before adding the oil.
example.chinese: 加油之前先把锅加热。

application.prompt: ___ the milk gently before you pour it into the cup. A. Slice B. Heat
application.solution: B。解析：让牛奶变热用动词 heat。

examTags: 语法·不可数名词与熟词多义
grammar: n. 食用油；石油；燃油。通常不可数；可用 cooking oil 指食用油，oils 可指不同种类的油。
collocations: a little oil; cooking oil; oil the pan
commonMistake: 泛指食用油或石油时通常不可数，不说 an oil；不同种类或作品中的油可用 oils。

example.english: Put a little oil in the pan before cooking.
example.chinese: 烹饪前在锅里放一点油。

application.prompt: Use a small amount of cooking ___ to fry the eggs. A. oil B. bowl
application.solution: A。解析：煎蛋会用 cooking oil（食用油）。

grammar: n. 平底锅；烤盘。可数名词，复数 pans；frying pan 常指煎锅。
collocations: a frying pan; heat a pan; cook in a pan
commonMistake: pan 是可数名词；表示用锅烹饪说 in a pan 或 on a pan 的具体用法依食物和动作而定。

example.english: She warmed the oil in a pan.
example.chinese: 她在平底锅里把油加热。

application.prompt: Use a frying ___ to cook the eggs on the stove. A. spoon B. pan
application.solution: B。解析：煎蛋常用 frying pan（煎锅）。

grammar: phr. 把某物放回原处。是可分短语动词；代词宾语必须放在 put 和 back 之间。
collocations: put the jar back; put it back on the shelf; put the book back
commonMistake: 宾语是代词时说 put it back，不说 put back it；back 后常用地点介词短语说明放回哪里。

example.english: After using the flour, put it back in the cupboard.
example.chinese: 面粉用完后把它放回橱柜里。

application.prompt: The spoon belongs in the drawer. Please put ___ back. A. back it B. it
application.solution: B。解析：代词宾语放在可分短语动词中间：put it back。

grammar: phr. 把……和……混合。结构为 mix A with B，也可说 mix A and B together。
collocations: mix flour with water; mix sugar with butter; mix the two ingredients together
commonMistake: mix A with B 两部分都要有；with 后接被混合的另一种材料。

example.english: Mix the sugar with the melted butter.
example.chinese: 把糖和融化的黄油混合。

application.prompt: To make the dough, ___ the flour ___ water. A. cut; into B. mix; with
application.solution: B。解析：把面粉和水混合用 mix A with B。

examTags: 语法·形容词与副词辨析
grammar: adj. 简单的；朴素的。可修饰名词或作表语；副词为 simply，比较级 simpler。
collocations: a simple recipe; a simple question; keep it simple
commonMistake: simple 是形容词，修饰名词；修饰动词需用 simply。

example.english: This simple recipe needs only four ingredients.
example.chinese: 这个简单的食谱只需要四种食材。

application.prompt: The instructions are easy to follow, so the recipe is ___. A. simple B. sour
application.solution: A。解析：simple 表示“简单的”。

grammar: n. 食材；成分。可数名词，复数 ingredients；常用 ingredient in/of a dish。
collocations: fresh ingredients; list the ingredients; an ingredient in the soup
commonMistake: ingredient 是可数名词；列出多种食材时用复数 ingredients。

example.english: Read the recipe and prepare all the ingredients first.
example.chinese: 先读食谱并准备好所有食材。

application.prompt: Eggs and flour are two ___ in this cake. A. ingredients B. instructions
application.solution: A。解析：鸡蛋和面粉是蛋糕的食材，ingredient 的复数为 ingredients。

grammar: n. 用法说明；指示；操作指南。可数名词，食谱步骤中常用复数 instructions。
collocations: follow the instructions; read the cooking instructions; give clear instructions
commonMistake: 表示一组操作步骤通常用 instructions；instruction 也可指一条指示。

example.english: Follow the instructions carefully when you use the oven.
example.chinese: 使用烤箱时要仔细按照说明操作。

application.prompt: Read the recipe ___ before you start cooking. A. ingredients of B. instructions
application.solution: B。解析：食谱的操作步骤常说 instructions。

grammar: n. 清蒸鱼。steamed 是 steam 的过去分词作定语，表示用蒸汽烹制；fish 作菜名时通常不变形。
collocations: a plate of steamed fish; cook steamed fish; steamed fish with ginger
commonMistake: steamed fish 是“蒸鱼”这道菜；fish 作鱼肉或泛指鱼时通常不加复数 -s。

example.english: We ordered steamed fish with rice for dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭我们点了清蒸鱼和米饭。

application.prompt: Fish cooked with steam is called ___. A. steamed fish B. fried flour
application.solution: A。解析：用蒸汽做的鱼是 steamed fish。

grammar: adj. 酸的；有酸味的。可作定语或表语；sour 也可作动词表示变酸。
collocations: sour fruit; taste sour; sweet and sour
commonMistake: sour 描述味道“酸”；表示“酸辣”时按顺序说 hot and sour。

example.english: The lemon tasted very sour.
example.chinese: 这个柠檬尝起来很酸。

application.prompt: A lemon usually has a ___ taste. A. visible B. sour
application.solution: B。解析：柠檬常有酸味，sour 表示“酸的”。

grammar: n. 酸辣汤。hot and sour 两个并列形容词共同修饰 soup；作为菜名通常不可数或按份数计。
collocations: a bowl of hot and sour soup; make hot and sour soup; order the soup
commonMistake: hot and sour soup 是菜名；表示一碗时说 a bowl of hot and sour soup，不说 a soup（若非一份/一种）。

example.english: My father ordered a bowl of hot and sour soup.
example.chinese: 我爸爸点了一碗酸辣汤。

application.prompt: A soup that tastes both spicy and sour is ___. A. mashed potatoes B. hot and sour soup
application.solution: B。解析：酸辣汤的英文是 hot and sour soup。

examTags: 语法·可数与不可数用法
grammar: n. 脏乱；凌乱；一团糟。常用 make a mess、in a mess；作“混乱状态”时常见可数表达 a mess。
collocations: make a mess; a messy kitchen; clean up the mess
commonMistake: mess 是名词；形容“凌乱的”用 messy。固定搭配 in a mess 常有冠词 a。

example.english: The kitchen was a mess after we made the cake.
example.chinese: 做完蛋糕后，厨房一片凌乱。

application.prompt: There is flour on the table and dishes everywhere. What a ___! A. mess B. recipe
application.solution: A。解析：mess 可表示脏乱或一团糟。

examTags: 语法·形容词与程度副词
grammar: adj. 漂亮的；adv. 相当、十分。作副词时常修饰形容词或副词，如 pretty good。
collocations: a pretty dress; a pretty garden; pretty good; pretty quickly
commonMistake: pretty 可表示“漂亮的”或口语中的“相当”；句中位置和修饰对象决定词性。

example.english: The pumpkin pie was pretty good.
example.chinese: 南瓜派相当好吃。

application.prompt: The soup is ___ hot, so let it cool for a minute. A. prettyly B. pretty
application.solution: B。解析：pretty 作程度副词表示“相当”，形式不变。

grammar: n. 圣诞节。节日名称首字母大写；常用 at Christmas、on Christmas Day。
collocations: at Christmas; Christmas Day; a Christmas tree
commonMistake: Christmas 是节日专名，首字母必须大写；节日期间常说 at Christmas。

example.english: We bake cookies together at Christmas.
example.chinese: 圣诞节期间我们一起烤饼干。

application.prompt: The family decorates a tree ___ Christmas. A. at B. in
application.solution: A。解析：表示圣诞节期间常用 at Christmas。

grammar: n. 烙饼；薄煎饼。可数名词，复数 pancakes；常用 a pancake 或 a stack of pancakes。
collocations: make pancakes; a pancake with fruit; a stack of pancakes
commonMistake: pancake 是可数名词；表示多个薄饼时用 pancakes。

example.english: We made pancakes for breakfast on Sunday.
example.chinese: 星期天早餐我们做了薄煎饼。

application.prompt: A thin round cake cooked in a pan is a ___. A. pancake B. tablespoon
application.solution: A。解析：在平底锅里烙制的薄饼是 pancake。

grammar: n. 梦；梦想；v. 做梦；梦想。过去式和过去分词可为 dreamed 或 dreamt；dream of/about doing 表示梦想做某事。
collocations: have a dream; dream about a place; dream of becoming a cook
commonMistake: dream of/about 后表示梦想做某事常接动名词；dreamed 和 dreamt 都可作过去式。

example.english: She dreams of opening a small bakery one day.
example.chinese: 她梦想有一天开一家小面包店。

application.prompt: He wants to be a chef and often ___ of making new dishes. A. dreams to B. dreams
application.solution: B。解析：dream of 后常接名词或动名词；主语 he 用 dreams。

grammar: n.（综合性）大学；可数名词，复数 universities。a university 中 a 依据辅音音素 /j/，不是元音字母 u。
collocations: go to university; a university student; study at a university
commonMistake: university 虽以元音字母 u 开头，但读音以 /j/ 开始，所以说 a university。

example.english: Her brother studies biology at a university in the city.
example.chinese: 她哥哥在城里的一所大学学习生物。

application.prompt: My sister hopes to study at ___ university abroad. A. a B. an
application.solution: A。解析：university 的首音为辅音音素 /j/，前用 a。

grammar: phr. 去划船；去乘船游玩。go 后接 boating 这一活动名词（动名词形式）。
collocations: go boating on the lake; go boating with friends; go boating at the weekend
commonMistake: 表示参加户外活动常用 go + doing：go boating；不要说 go to boating。

example.english: We went boating on the lake during the holiday.
example.chinese: 假期里我们在湖上划船游玩。

application.prompt: The weather is calm, so let's ___ on the lake. A. go boating B. go to boating
application.solution: A。解析：go 后直接接活动动名词 boating。

examTags: 语法·可数与不可数用法
grammar: n. 回忆；记忆力。表示一段回忆时可数，复数 memories；表示记忆能力时常不可数。
collocations: a happy memory; childhood memories; have a good memory
commonMistake: memory 指一段回忆时是可数名词；复数为 memories（y 变 i 加 -es）。

example.english: Cooking with my grandmother is a happy memory.
example.chinese: 和奶奶一起做饭是一段快乐的回忆。

application.prompt: The trip gave us many wonderful ___. A. memories B. memorys
application.solution: A。解析：memory 的复数为 memories。

grammar: adj. 看得见的；可见的。常用 be visible to sb；反义词为 invisible。
collocations: clearly visible; visible from the road; be visible to the eye
commonMistake: visible 是形容词，常与 be 连用；副词“明显地”可用 visibly，不能用 visible 修饰动词。

example.english: The island was visible from the top of the hill.
example.chinese: 从山顶可以看到那座岛。

application.prompt: The sign can be seen clearly from far away. It is ___. A. visible B. simple
application.solution: A。解析：visible 表示“看得见的”。

grammar: phr. 与……一起；连同……。作主语补充成分时，谓语通常与 along with 前的核心主语保持一致。
collocations: along with my family; bring a spoon along with a bowl; along with the recipe
commonMistake: along with 连接的附加成分不改变核心主语的数；The cook, along with her helpers, is ready。

example.english: She brought the recipe along with a list of ingredients.
example.chinese: 她带来了食谱和一份食材清单。

application.prompt: The cook, along with two helpers, ___ ready to begin. A. is B. are
application.solution: A。解析：along with 短语不改变核心主语 the cook，谓语用 is。

grammar: n. 南瓜；可数名词，复数 pumpkins。
collocations: a pumpkin pie; carve a pumpkin; pumpkin seeds
commonMistake: pumpkin 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the 或其他限定词；复数加 -s。

example.english: They carved a pumpkin for the autumn festival.
example.chinese: 他们为秋季节庆雕刻了一个南瓜。

application.prompt: A large orange vegetable used to make pie is a ___. A. pumpkin B. cinnamon
application.solution: A。解析：南瓜派的主要食材是 pumpkin。

grammar: n. 果馅饼；肉馅饼。可数名词，复数 pies；常用 a piece of pie 表示一块。
collocations: pumpkin pie; apple pie; a piece of pie
commonMistake: pie 是可数名词；表示一块馅饼可说 a piece of pie，不能把 piece 漏掉。

example.english: We shared an apple pie after dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭后我们分吃了一个苹果派。

application.prompt: A baked dish with fruit inside is an apple ___. A. spoon B. pie
application.solution: B。解析：苹果馅饼是 apple pie。

grammar: phr.（使）变暖；热身；预热；也可表示使气氛活跃。宾语为代词时常放在 warm 与 up 之间。
collocations: warm up the soup; warm the food up; warm up before exercise
commonMistake: 代词宾语放中间：warm it up；warm up 也可不接宾语，表示自己热身。

example.english: Warm up the soup before serving it.
example.chinese: 上桌前把汤热一热。

application.prompt: The soup is cold. Please warm ___ up before lunch. A. it B. up it
application.solution: A。解析：warm up 是可分短语动词，代词必须放中间。

grammar: n. 肉桂皮；桂皮香料。作香料时通常不可数；表示一根肉桂棒可说 a cinnamon stick。
collocations: ground cinnamon; cinnamon sticks; add cinnamon to the pie
commonMistake: cinnamon 作香料通常不可数；不要说 a cinnamon 表示一些肉桂粉。

example.english: A little cinnamon gives the pie a warm smell.
example.chinese: 少许肉桂让馅饼散发出温暖的香气。

application.prompt: This brown spice is often added to apple pie. It is ___. A. butter B. cinnamon
application.solution: B。解析：肉桂是常用于苹果派的香料。

grammar: phr.（使）充满；（使）填满。结构为 fill A with B，A 是被装满的容器或空间，B 是填入的东西。
collocations: fill a bowl with water; fill the room with music; fill a pie with fruit
commonMistake: 固定结构是 fill A with B；不要把被填入的内容放在 fill 后、地点宾语前而漏掉 with。

example.english: Fill the pie with pumpkin before you bake it.
example.chinese: 烘烤前把南瓜馅装进派里。

application.prompt: We ___ the bowl ___ fresh fruit. A. pour; of B. fill; with
application.solution: B。解析：把容器装满某物用 fill A with B。

grammar: n. 甜；甜味；也可指温柔或悦耳。通常不可数，由 sweet 加 -ness 构成。
collocations: the sweetness of the fruit; add sweetness; natural sweetness
commonMistake: sweetness 是抽象名词，通常不加 a；描述食物“甜的”用形容词 sweet。

example.english: The apples add natural sweetness to the pie.
example.chinese: 苹果给馅饼增添了天然甜味。

application.prompt: The fruit gives the sauce a little natural ___. A. sweetness B. sweet
application.solution: A。解析：a little 后接不可数名词 sweetness；sweet 是形容词。

grammar: n. 学院；大学。可数名词，复数 colleges；不同国家对 college 和 university 的范围用法不同。
collocations: go to college; a college student; a college of music
commonMistake: college 与 university 都可指高等教育机构，但具体制度因国家而异；注意二者前均可用 a。

example.english: Her sister hopes to study cooking at college.
example.chinese: 她姐姐希望在大学学习烹饪。

application.prompt: After high school, he plans to go to ___. A. college B. cinnamon
application.solution: A。解析：完成高中学业后可以 go to college（上大学/学院）。

grammar: n. 主人；东道主；v. 主办；主持（活动）。作名词可数，复数 hosts；过去式 hosted。
collocations: a kind host; host a dinner; host a cooking show
commonMistake: host 作名词指主人或主持人，作动词指主办、主持；过去式直接加 -ed：hosted。

example.english: Our neighbor will host a dinner for the cooking club.
example.chinese: 邻居将为烹饪社团举办一场晚餐活动。

application.prompt: The school will ___ a food festival next month. A. separate B. host
application.solution: B。解析：主办活动用动词 host。

grammar: n. 女主人；女房东；也可指女主持人。复数 hostesses；现代语境中 host 常可泛指不同性别的主人或主持人。
collocations: the hostess of the party; a restaurant hostess; welcome guests as a hostess
commonMistake: hostess 是传统女性形式；host 可作不特指性别的主人或主持人。

example.english: The hostess welcomed everyone into the kitchen.
example.chinese: 女主人把大家迎进厨房。

application.prompt: The woman who welcomed guests to the dinner was the ___. A. ingredient B. hostess
application.solution: B。解析：hostess 可指女主人。

grammar: n. 食谱；烹饪法。可数名词，复数 recipes；常包括食材清单和制作步骤。
collocations: a recipe for soup; follow a recipe; a family recipe
commonMistake: recipe 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a/the；复数拼写为 recipes。

example.english: This recipe shows how to make a simple pumpkin pie.
example.chinese: 这份食谱介绍了如何制作简单的南瓜派。

application.prompt: Read the ___ to find out how much flour you need. A. recipe B. memory
application.solution: A。解析：食谱 recipe 会列出所需食材和用量。

grammar: n. 奶油；护肤霜。作食品原料通常不可数；指一罐护肤霜或具体品种时可数。
collocations: whipped cream; a carton of cream; face cream
commonMistake: cream 作奶油时通常不可数，不说 a cream；表示一份或一罐时可用 some cream/a carton of cream。

example.english: We served the pie with a little cream.
example.chinese: 我们在馅饼旁配了一点奶油。

application.prompt: Add some ___ to the fruit if you want a richer dessert. A. cream B. crusts
application.solution: A。解析：奶油可作为甜点配料，cream 常作不可数名词。

grammar: n. 糕饼酥皮；面包皮；可数名词，复数 crusts。
collocations: pie crust; a slice of bread with the crust; a crispy crust
commonMistake: crust 指面包外皮或派的酥皮；不要与表示“地壳”的 crust 混淆语境。

example.english: The pie has a crisp crust and a soft filling.
example.chinese: 这个派外皮酥脆，馅料松软。

application.prompt: The hard outside layer of a pie is its ___. A. sweetness B. crust
application.solution: B。解析：派的外层酥皮叫 crust。

grammar: n. 混合物；混合；结合体。可数名词，复数 mixtures；由 mix 加后缀 -ture 构成。
collocations: a mixture of flour and water; stir the mixture; a mixture of colors
commonMistake: mixture 是名词，指混合后的物质；mix 可作动词或名词表示混合、混合料。

example.english: Pour the mixture into the baking dish.
example.chinese: 把混合物倒入烤盘。

application.prompt: After you mix the eggs and flour, pour the ___ into the pan. A. instruction B. mixture
application.solution: B。解析：混合后的材料叫 mixture。

grammar: adv./pron. 最少；最小。是 little 的最高级形式之一；可与 the 连用，也常见 at least。
collocations: the least amount; at least one; least of all
commonMistake: least 常与 the 连用作最高级；at least 表示“至少”，不要误解为“最少地”。

example.english: Use the least amount of salt that still tastes good.
example.chinese: 在味道仍合适的前提下尽量少放盐。

application.prompt: Which amount is the smallest? Choose the ___. A. most B. least
application.solution: B。解析：least 表示“最少”，most 表示“最多”。

grammar: phr. 至少；不低于某个数量或程度。常放在数量、时间或程度表达前。
collocations: at least two eggs; wait at least ten minutes; at least once a week
commonMistake: at least 表示“不少于、至少”；其反义表达之一是 at most（至多）。

example.english: Bake the pie for at least thirty minutes.
example.chinese: 这个派至少要烤三十分钟。

application.prompt: The recipe needs ___ three eggs, so buy four to be safe. A. at least B. at most
application.solution: A。解析：需要三只或更多表示 at least three；at most 是至多。

grammar: n. 秘密；诀窍；adj. 秘密的；保密的。作名词可数，复数 secrets；常用 the secret to/of...。
collocations: a family secret; the secret to good bread; keep a secret
commonMistake: 表示“……的诀窍”常说 the secret to...；secret 作形容词时放在名词前，如 a secret recipe。

example.english: The secret to a soft pie crust is cold butter.
example.chinese: 酥软派皮的诀窍是使用冷黄油。

application.prompt: The cook shared the ___ to making her pumpkin pie. A. island B. secret
application.solution: B。解析：the secret to... 表示“……的诀窍”。

grammar: phr. 根据；依照。后接名词、代词或名词性短语，说明信息、规则或来源。
collocations: according to the recipe; according to the instructions; according to my teacher
commonMistake: according to 后接来源或规则；不能直接接完整主谓句，可改用 according to what...。

example.english: According to the recipe, the pie needs one cup of flour.
example.chinese: 根据食谱，这个派需要一杯面粉。

application.prompt: ___ the instructions, bake the cake for 25 minutes. A. Along with to B. According to
application.solution: B。解析：表示“根据说明”用 according to。

grammar: adv./conj. 每当；在任何时候。引导时间状语从句，表示每次某事发生；从句可用一般现在时表达将来时间。
collocations: whenever you need help; call whenever you like; whenever I cook
commonMistake: whenever 引导时间从句时，表示将来常用一般现在时：Whenever you arrive, call me。

example.english: Whenever I bake, I read the recipe twice first.
example.chinese: 每当烘焙时，我都会先把食谱读两遍。

application.prompt: You can ask me for the recipe ___ you need it. A. whenever B. unless of
application.solution: A。解析：whenever 表示“在任何需要的时候”。

grammar: n. 项目；一件物品；一条。可数名词，复数 items；常指清单中的一项或一件商品。
collocations: a shopping item; a list of items; each item on the menu
commonMistake: item 是可数名词；清单中多项用 items，不要与表示“食材”的 ingredient 混淆。

example.english: Check each item on the shopping list before you leave.
example.chinese: 出门前检查购物清单上的每一项。

application.prompt: Write every food you need as an ___ on the list. A. island B. item
application.solution: B。解析：清单中的一项可称为 item。

examTags: 语法·不可数名词与量词
grammar: n. 意大利细面条；通常作不可数名词。可说 a plate/bowl of spaghetti；也可表示一根面条时用 a strand of spaghetti。
collocations: a plate of spaghetti; cook spaghetti; spaghetti with tomato sauce
commonMistake: spaghetti 通常不可数，不说 a spaghetti；表示一份可说 a plate of spaghetti。

example.english: We had spaghetti with tomato sauce for lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭我们吃了番茄酱意大利面。

application.prompt: For dinner, they cooked a large plate of ___. A. spaghetti B. spaghettis
application.solution: A。解析：spaghetti 通常作不可数名词，不加复数 -s。

grammar: n. 勺；一勺的量。可数名词，复数 spoons；a spoonful of 表示“一勺……”。
collocations: a teaspoon; a spoonful of sugar; stir with a spoon
commonMistake: spoon 指勺子；要表达一勺食材可用 a spoonful of，不能用 spoon 直接修饰不可数名词。

example.english: Add one spoonful of sugar and stir with a spoon.
example.chinese: 加一勺糖，再用勺子搅拌。

application.prompt: Use a ___ to stir the tea. A. spoon B. crust
application.solution: A。解析：搅拌茶水的餐具是 spoon（勺子）。

grammar: n. 薄片；片；v. 把……切成薄片；切。slice sth into slices 表示把某物切成片。
collocations: a slice of bread; slice the apple; slice the cheese thinly
commonMistake: slice 作名词时可说 a slice of bread；作动词时直接接被切的食物作宾语。

example.english: Slice the tomatoes and put them on the bread.
example.chinese: 把西红柿切成片并放在面包上。

application.prompt: Cut the cucumber into thin pieces. Please ___ it. A. boil B. slice
application.solution: B。解析：把黄瓜切成薄片用 slice。

grammar: n. 夫妻；情侣；两人；a couple of + 复数名词表示“两三个/一对”，依语境理解。
collocations: a young couple; a couple of eggs; a couple of days
commonMistake: a couple of 后接复数名词；在日常表达中常指两个或少量几个，具体数量看语境。

example.english: The couple made dinner together at home.
example.chinese: 这对夫妻在家一起做了晚饭。

application.prompt: Add a ___ of eggs to the mixture. A. bowl B. couple
application.solution: B。解析：a couple of eggs 表示两个鸡蛋。

grammar: n. 岛；可数名词，复数 islands。首字母 s 不发音，单数前用 an。
collocations: a small island; live on an island; an island in the lake
commonMistake: island 的 s 不发音，因此说 an island；表示住在岛上常用 on an island。

example.english: They grow pumpkins on a small island.
example.chinese: 他们在一座小岛上种南瓜。

application.prompt: We took a boat to ___ island in the lake. A. a B. an
application.solution: B。解析：island 的首音是元音音素，前用 an。

grammar: n. 妻子；可数名词，复数 wives（f 变 v 加 -es）。
collocations: his wife; a husband and wife; wives and husbands
commonMistake: wife 的复数是 wives，不是 wifes；类似变化还有 knife—knives。

example.english: His wife made a pie for the family.
example.chinese: 他的妻子为家人做了一个派。

application.prompt: The two men and their ___ prepared dinner together. A. wives B. wifes
application.solution: A。解析：wife 的不规则复数为 wives。

grammar: adj. 分开的；独立的；v.（使）分开。常用 separate A from B；副词 separately。
collocations: separate bowls; separate the eggs; separate A from B
commonMistake: separate 作动词时常用 separate A from B；拼写中有两个 a，不要写成 seperate。

example.english: Separate the dry ingredients from the wet ones.
example.chinese: 把干性食材和湿性食材分开。

application.prompt: Keep the raw eggs ___ from the cooked food. A. separate B. visiblely
application.solution: A。解析：be separate from 表示“与……分开”。

grammar: v./adj. 出生；天生的。是 bear 的过去分词，常用于 be born；be born with sth 表示天生具有某特点。
collocations: be born in 2012; be born on Monday; be born with a talent
commonMistake: “出生于”用 be born in/on；born 不能单独作主动动词说 I born。

example.english: My grandmother was born on an island.
example.chinese: 我奶奶出生在一座岛上。

application.prompt: He ___ born in a small town in 2012. A. did B. was
application.solution: B。解析：出生用被动结构 be born，主语 he 配 was。

grammar: phr. 逐个地；逐一地。常作状语，说明动作依次发生；同义表达 one after another。
collocations: read the steps one by one; add ingredients one by one; answer one by one
commonMistake: 固定表达为 one by one，表示依次；不说 one by ones。

example.english: Add the ingredients to the bowl one by one.
example.chinese: 把食材逐个放进碗里。

application.prompt: The students came into the kitchen ___ to wash their hands. A. at least B. one by one
application.solution: B。解析：表示“逐个地”用 one by one。
